description: This file defines template classes for control mechanisms within the WPEFramework Messaging namespace, including ControlType and LocalLifetimeType, which manage control metadata, enable/disable states, and registration of control units.

classes.name: ControlType
classes.description: Template class managing control metadata and enable/disable state, implementing IControl interface.

classes.name: LocalLifetimeType
classes.description: Template class providing static control management functions, including enabling/disabling and metadata access.

methods.name: ControlType(const bool enabled)
methods.description: Constructor initializing control with enabled state and metadata, and registering control.

methods.name: ~ControlType()
methods.description: Destructor that calls Destroy to revoke control.

methods.name: void Enable(const bool enabled)
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the control.

methods.name: static bool IsEnabled()
methods.description: Checks if the control is enabled.
